title: Non-convex integer programming: a deterministic solution method of the large block sale problem
summary: We study a non-convex, nonlinear integer mathematical program with a linear constraint. This problem originates in finance and consists of selling a large predetermined quantity of a financial asset over a fixed time horizon, while maximizing the total proceeds. The selling price is modeled using a deterministic penalty function capturing the market's adverse reaction to the selling flow. From a complexity perspective, the problem is in NP.
